messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix zombies clipping underground in the attached Mall Run 3D game and leave the existing game playable on phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Apply the requested change without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Restored the attached game as the project’s `index.html`.
- Corrected the crawl pose by keeping the zombie root at ground level and lifting it based on the posed mesh bounds.

## Work State
### Completed
- Downloaded the attachment from `https://omgithub.com/api/issue-attachments/ccda033e-56ca-4af9-8228-af58bd423685`.
- Added the game to `index.html`.
- Changed crawler placement from `z.g.position.y=-.9` to `0`; added `zombieBounds` and a floor-bound adjustment after applying crawl animation.
- Extracted the inline script and confirmed `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` passes.
- Loaded the game at `http://localhost:3002`; browser showed the Mall Run 3D page. The only console error seen was a missing `favicon.ico` (404).

### Active
- Validate the crawl-floor adjustment and the game visually/in-browser, ideally with a JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- No outstanding blockers.

## Next Move
1. Inspect/test the crawl pose in browser; save and read a latest small JPEG screenshot.
2. Consider whether to add an automated runtime check for the mesh floor bound if browser interaction can expose crawler state.
3. Report the fix, validation results, and reasonable assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: restored game and zombie crawl clipping fix.
- `/tmp/opencode/mall-run-3d.html`: downloaded source attachment for comparison.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; repository also had unrelated untracked project files already present.
- Browser session opened at `http://localhost:3002`; local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` was run successfully; browser is available.
